p.write_text('''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    if len(counts) < 2:
        return [[0 for _ in row] for row in grid]
    (major, nmajor), (minor, nminor) = counts.most_common(2)
    total = sum(counts.values())
    # Sparse-mark mode: erase the less frequent color and recolor the
    # background with its former mark color. Very narrow grids use this mode too.
    sparse_mode = (nminor / total < 0.20) or len(grid[0]) <= 10
    if sparse_mode:
        return [[0 if v == minor else minor for v in row] for row in grid]
    return [[0 if v == major else major for v in row] for row in grid]
''')
